specification.objective: Replace ordinary in-app content-loading spinners with reusable accessible animated skeletons while preserving startup, submission, routing, authorization and existing loading/error/empty behavior.

requirements.statement: One shared configurable skeleton primitive supports composable shapes, one animation controller per loading region, system reduced motion, theme colors, text scaling and responsive widths.
Route-session and Kanban skeletons reuse the shared primitive without changing their layout, keys or board rendering foundation.
Every ordinary content-loading spinner in Audit, Employees, Kanban, Projects/Tasks, time tracking and work-log task lists is replaced by a content-shaped skeleton.
Action submissions use disabled controls with accessible pending text/status and never use a content skeleton or spinner.
Workspace shell/navigation remains mounted; existing success, empty, error, retry, pagination, auth/revocation behavior and API contracts are preserved.
Skeleton regions expose one live announcement; decorative blocks are hidden from assistive technology; reduced motion stops animation and leaves no running ticker.
No dependency is added; only startup splash retains the CircularProgressIndicator, with the #113 audit export LinearProgressIndicator as its narrowly documented action-progress exception.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A shared primitive and region are reused by all migrated surfaces and route-session/Kanban skeletons.
Loading to success/empty/error remains usable and preserves scoped retry/pagination and workspace shell.
Reduced motion renders a static skeleton without a running ticker; animated regions use one controller; decorative blocks are excluded and the region label appears once.

Representative production ProjectTasksPage loading state is visually inspected at desktop and mobile browser viewports using a reproducible harness; responsive layout has no observed horizontal overflow.
Only the startup splash CircularProgressIndicator and narrowly contextualized audit-export LinearProgressIndicator remain; no added dependency or altered API contract.
Flutter analysis, focused and full test suites, build/smoke where available, git diff check, and complete diff review pass.
A repeatable browser harness renders the production ProjectTasksPage with a pending API response and retains the desktop/mobile visual inspection evidence.

invariants.statement: Circular progress remains exclusively for cold-start server waiting; action pending states use disabled controls and accessible status.
API contracts, auth/revocation, existing loading/error/empty/retry/pagination semantics, and Kanban board rendering behavior do not change.
No external dependency is introduced; current workspace visual language and responsive behavior are preserved.

forbidden_states.statement: Ordinary in-app content loading uses a circular/refresh/Cupertino spinner.
Submission is represented by a misleading skeleton or inaccessible pending state.
Reduced motion leaves an active animation ticker or decorative blocks exposed to assistive technology.

inputs.statement: Current content loading regions, their surrounding workspace shell, and accessible labels.

outputs.statement: Reusable skeleton regions and page-specific skeleton compositions with preserved loading transitions.

failure_semantics.statement: If any ordinary content loading indicator remains outside the startup splash and the narrowly scoped audit export progress action, the source inventory regression exits nonzero and identifies the offending path/token.
